text:
nora: quick sync 1: want to finalize creative and routing for the 'cost vs responsiveness' piece. aiming for launch next Tues.

james: timeline OK. we need: hero visual, two one-liners (prod & infra), webinar outline, and a gating form for downloads.

lee: for hero i propose a compact 2-axis viz: x=median latency ms (log scale), y=$ per 1k tokens. highlight our recommended sweet-spot band.

talia: +1. also include a tiny inset showing batching + cache delta as percentages. i mocked sample numbers: 
```
model,lat_ms,cost_per_k
redwood-7b,60,0.045
redwood-13b-opt,130,0.07
open-13b,90,0.05
gptx-lite,220,0.13
```

james: copy variants for testing: A) "Control costs, protect latency" B) "Predictable SLAs at lower spend". we'll run headline A/B on the landing.

nora: good. landing CTA flows: download kit (email capture), sign up webinar, start Dedicated trial. routing: >20 seats -> AE; else nurture.

lee: webinar plan: 25m demo (cache+batching tour), 15m customer panel, 10m Q&A. promo blurb: "Hands-on: tuning serving for better UX and unit economics"

talia: design asks: need 1) hero PNG 1200x628, 2) three microcards (chat/search/rerank), 3) small animated GIF showing latency improvement after batching.

james: also need two pull-quotes for email drip and a short tech note (200 words) explaining measurement methodology and SLA bands.

nora: measurement note bullets: - median and p95 over 1h steady-state - cost model includes batching, KV cache savings - load profile: 50-200 qps dependent slices

lee: can we surface one real example? e.g., a doc-search customer: 25% token cost reduction with prefix cache, p95 latency within SLA. anonymized numbers OK.

talia: design has one slot for a customer logo; hold for approval.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: assets folder created s3://redwood-marketing/econ-assets/5280/ ; tracking pixels stashed in GTM.

james: analytics: track source + headline variant, webinar RSVP count, kit downloads, and AE handoffs. convert AE handoff into a task in SFDC.

nora: action owners: lee (hero + microcards) by EOD Fri, talia (GIF + social copy) by Mon AM, james (AB copy + form + tracking) by Fri noon. i'll draft the blog + tweet after hero lands.

lee: i'll push two hero drafts into Figma and ping here when ready.

talia: social plan: 3 posts week of launch, 2 story versions for linkedin, one short demo clip for twitter/instagram.

james: reminder: for the A/B, we capture headline click-through and also the email subject line for later follow-ups.

nora: perfect. small async: if anyone has objections to the routing thresholds speak now, else i'll lock it.

lee: no objections.

ops-bot: marketing-run-5280: content repo populated. preview links: https://preview.redwood.com/econ/5280 :white_check_mark:
